title: dev-team model capability profile
description: One complete record about one model on one runtime. Every field is present; the text UNKNOWN means it is not known. Provenance says where each known field came from.

provider.description: The provider word, such as anthropic or openai.

runtime.description: The tool that runs the model, such as claude-code or codex.

providerModelId.description: The model's name as the provider or tool gives it.

availability.description: AVAILABLE when confirmed usable now, otherwise UNKNOWN.

lifecycleStatus.description: Where the model is in its life: ACTIVE, LEGACY (a successor is named), RETIRED? (missing once), RETIRED (missing twice), or UNKNOWN.

contextWindow.description: How much text the model can take in at once, in tokens, or UNKNOWN.

reasoningControls.description: The effort levels that can be set, or UNKNOWN.

defaultReasoning.description: The effort level used when none is set, or UNKNOWN.

runtimeCapabilities.description: What the runtime can do (file access, shell, and so on), or UNKNOWN.

capabilityTier.description: Strength: 1 utility to 4 principal, or UNKNOWN.

canaryStage.description: How far the model is trusted: PROVISIONAL, VALIDATED, TRUSTED or UNKNOWN.

latencyClass.description: How quickly it answers, or UNKNOWN.

relativeCostClass.description: A rough relative cost from 1 (cheap) to 9 (dear), or UNKNOWN. Not a bill.

confidence.description: How sure the engine is of this record, 0 to 1.

lastValidated.description: When the record was last checked, or UNKNOWN.

provenance.description: For each field that was actually filled in, where it came from: RUNTIME_DISCOVERY, COMPAT_DATA or HEURISTIC.
